intuition: A subsequence is formed by matching the requested characters in order while allowing gaps in the source.

brute_force.approach: Enumerate subsequences of t and compare each one with s.

optimal.approach: Advance a pointer in s whenever the next source character matches it during one scan of t.

edge_cases: An empty s is a subsequence of every t.
A longer s cannot match a shorter t.
Repeated characters must be matched in order.
